reviews.title: Essential Features Locked Behind a Paywall
reviews.text:
Librus is a disappointing example of how NOT to design a mobile application.
First, the iOS app feels like little more than a website wrapped in an embedded browser. There seems to be very little effort put into creating a proper native app or delivering a good user experience. It doesn't feel like an application designed specifically for iOS, but rather a bare-minimum wrapper around an existing website.
But the biggest problem is the business model. This is a subscription-based app that puts essential features behind a paywall. School messages, reminders, homework assignments, push notifications, and other basic functionality are locked behind a subscription. Once the trial period expires, the app becomes practically useless.
What's particularly frustrating is that there are plenty of alternative monetization models. Why not offer a free version supported by ads, like countless other freemium apps? Users who want an ad-free experience could pay for a subscription, while everyone else could still access the basic features they need. Instead, Librus chooses to put essential school communication behind a paywall.
And here's the real problem: parents don't have a choice. Schools use Librus as their communication platform, so parents are effectively forced to pay a subscription just to stay informed about their children's education.

reviews.title: Wzorcowy przykład złej roboty deweloperskiej
reviews.text: Librus jest przykładem apki rodzonej w głowach źle opłacanych studentów informatyki, terroryzowanych przez narcystyczną osobowość szefa-biznesmena, którzy nauczyli się na uczelni języka C++ a świat poszedł w kierunku apek webowych na pythonie. I co biedni studenci klepią ten zacofany GUI, w którym brakuje możliwości usuwania profilu, przycisków wstecz, zapamiętywania struktury okna głównego a szef im ciągle przypomina „I muszą być reklamy”. Czyste zło kapitalizmu lat 90-tych, zwalczające oddolne ruchy próbujące coś naprawić. Syf i malaria.Wypatruję kiedy pojawi się edziennik z MEN
